g.text: ‘SNL’ Sets John Mulaney’s Seventh Time Hosting With Phoebe Bridgers as Musical Guest, Plus Druski and the Strokes ◆ Sam Heughan to Star With Viola Davis in Paramount+ Thriller Series ‘Ascent’ ◆ FIFA Opens Bids for 2030 World Cup U.S. Media Rights — With Option For 2034 ◆ ‘Carrie’ Renewed for Season 2 at Amazon ◆ ‘The Gilded Age’ Team on Paramount Merger Parallels and Going From Budget Cuts to a Season 3 Breakout: ‘You’re Part of a Very Fortunate Minority’ ◆ ‘Dungeon Crawler Carl’ Comic Book Series Launching in January (EXCLUSIVE) ◆
